_description: Jira project configuration for Project Clarity Phase 1. Import epics and stories into Jira.

customFields.name: Pain Point
customFields.description: Reference to business case pain point (e.g., 3.1)

epics.title: Data Architecture & Schema
epics.description: PostgreSQL schema design, master data tables, migration scripts

stories.title: Design PostgreSQL schema for all entities
Create migration scripts for master data tables (resources, customers, roles, skills, locations)
Create migration scripts for transactional tables (SOWs, assignments, timesheets, resource plans)
Seed database with mock data from mockData.ts
Set up database connection pooling and health checks

epics.title: Auth & User Management
epics.description: OAuth 2.0 setup, JWT middleware, RBAC, row-level security

stories.title: Implement JWT auth middleware
Create RBAC permission checking middleware
Implement row-level security filters for timesheets, assignments, SOWs
Create mock auth provider for local dev (bypass real OAuth)
Build login page and auth flow UI

epics.title: Master Data Management APIs
epics.description: CRUD APIs for customers, resources, roles, skills, locations, calendars

stories.title: Customer master API (list, get by ID, search)
Resource/employee master API (list, get, filter by location/role)
Role and rate card API (list roles, get standard rates by location)
Skills taxonomy API (hierarchical: practice > sub-practice > competency > skill)
Holiday calendar API (by location, by customer)
MSA repository API (list, get by customer, get clauses)

epics.title: SOW Creation Engine

stories.title: SOW template API (list templates, get by type, get fields)
SOW creation API (create draft, save progress, submit)
Auto-populate fields from customer/MSA/opportunity selection
Real-time margin calculation endpoint
Approval routing logic (standard/escalated/SLT based on margin)
SOW approval API (approve, reject with comments)
SOW document generation (PDF/Word from template)
SOW creation wizard UI (multi-step form)
SOW approval dashboard UI
Legal clause auto-injection with manual review flags

epics.title: Resource Planning & Capacity Engine
epics.description: Baseline/execution plans, weekly capacity, utilization alerts

stories.title: Resource plan API (create baseline, create execution, update)
Baseline plan lock mechanism (immutable after SOW signing)
Weekly capacity calculation engine
Utilization alert engine (>100% over-allocation, <60% underutilization)
Resource allocation API (assign resource to project, update %)
Capacity dashboard UI (resource view, project view, practice view)
Color-coded utilization display (Red >100%, Yellow 80-100%, Green <80%)
Drill-down: click resource to see all project allocations by week

epics.title: Assignment Automation

stories.title: Assignment creation API with JobDiva integration
Capacity validation at assignment time
Bill rate validation against standard rates
Assignment audit trail (DB logging)
Back-office notification on assignment creation
Assignment form UI
Assignment history/audit trail UI

stories.title: Burnt report generation API (by project, by period)
Variance calculation engine (hours, cost, margin)

Burnt report dashboard UI with color-coded status

Export burnt report to Excel/PDF
